xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The company has received demand order alleging flavored milk should be classified under GST Tariff Heading No. 2202 9930, attracting a tax rate of 6% CGST and 6% SGST. Consequently, it sought a differential GST liability of Rs.35.18 million for the period from July 2007 to March 2020, along with a penalty of Rs.35.28 million plus applicable interest. The Company has paid an amount of Rs.35.18 million under protest without prejudice to the rights and contentions of the law. The Company had filed a Writ Petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh challenging the demand order on 18-11-2021, After reviewing the matter, the Hon’ble High Court has issued a favorable order dated 29-01-2025 by setting aside the demand and court ruled that flavored milk falls under Tariff Heading No. 0402 9990, which attracting the tax rate of 2.5% CGST and 2.5% SGST and directed the Company to file the refund application for the differential tax already paid.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The company has received the favorable order from the Honorable High Court of AP on 29-01-2025. With due respect to the Hon’ble High Court order the Company has filed the refund application for pre deposit of tax on 21/02/2025.The refund application is accepted by the department and the same is in process.
